downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.56.2（Windows）。Mac 版暂为 v1.55.30，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.56.2 for Windows; the Mac build is still v1.55.30. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 多品种同步复盘：一个存档可加入多个陪跑品种，在同一时钟上与主品种同步回放；同市场、同账户体系的品种可直接交易并共用一个账户的保证金，跨市场品种作参考显示。陪跑品种随存档保存，并随复盘进度自动续载数据。
highlights.en: Multi-symbol replay: add companion symbols to a session and replay them on one shared clock. Symbols in the same market and account type can be traded against the shared account margin; cross-market symbols show as references. Companions are saved with the session and keep loading data ahead of the replay.

highlights.zh: 品种列表视图：集中查看存档内全部品种的最新价、日涨跌、持仓与浮动盈亏，可添加、移出品种并分配到窗格；单击某行即把下单面板切到该品种，多个窗格可显示同一品种。工具栏布局按钮一键在图表与列表间切换。
highlights.en: Symbol list view: see every symbol in the session with its latest price, daily change, positions and floating P&L; add or remove symbols and assign them to panes. Click a row to switch the order ticket to that symbol, show the same symbol in several panes, and flip between charts and the list with the toolbar layout button.

highlights.zh: 批量下单：勾选多个品种后一次按各自报价开出多笔市价单，逐品种设置手数，止损止盈按点数分别换算，策略名与入场笔记写到每笔持仓。
highlights.en: Batch orders: tick several symbols and place market orders on all of them at once, each at its own quote, with per-symbol lot sizes, point-based stops and targets, and the strategy name and entry note stamped on every position.

highlights.zh: MT5 同步（Beta）：在软件内安装随附的 EA 并自动配置，MT5 账户已完成的交易自动进入账单；账户列表显示 EA 心跳状态。
highlights.en: MT5 sync (Beta): install and configure the bundled EA from inside the app so completed MT5 trades flow into your statements automatically; the accounts list shows the EA heartbeat.

highlights.zh: 图表会预先绘制下一日 / 周 / 月的周期分隔线；交易历史新增可选的「盈亏点数」列；云备份设置导入改为先选文件再输密码；下载浏览器分类默认折叠。
highlights.en: Charts now draw the upcoming day, week and month separators ahead of the cursor; trade history gains an optional P&L-in-points column; cloud-backup settings import now picks the file before asking for the password; the download browser collapses categories by default.

highlights.zh: 修复复盘后退在 Tick 存档中卡住、图表显示菜单被右侧面板遮挡、存档信息与账户详情在矮屏上无法滚动的问题。
highlights.en: Fixed replay step-back stalling in tick sessions, the chart display menu being hidden behind the right panel, and session info and account details being unscrollable on short screens.

highlights.zh: 修复「% 名义本金」手续费按 100 倍收取、每手固定手续费与按金额触发的分批规则未按账户货币计算、整数手期货按百分比平仓被整仓平掉、清空数据后重新下载「全部」不完整、早期资料库无法下载外汇数据等问题。
highlights.en: Fixed percentage-of-notional commission charging 100× the intended rate, per-lot commission and money-based scaling rules not using the account currency, percentage closes wiping whole-lot futures positions, incomplete re-downloads after clearing data, and FX downloads failing on older libraries.
